## Fixes

- **Scene screenshots keep their shape.** A screenshot the other way round to your tiles, such as a portrait video on landscape tiles, is now shown whole with black bars at the sides, rather than cropped to a strip of its middle, as folder covers already are. A landscape screenshot on portrait tiles gets bars above and below. This applies to scene tiles, the hover preview and Downloads. Screenshots the same way round as the tiles fill them as before.
